source_text:
9.13
Οὐκ ἐπελάθετο τῆς δεήσεως τῶν πενήτων.
Τοιαύτη τίς η ν; ̔Η διὰ τῶν ὀλοφύρσεων καὶ τῶν θρήνων γενομένη, οι όν τινα
αι τησιν ε χουσα περὶ τῶν κατεχόντων δεινῶν.
pass_a_gloss: Not he-forgot of-the petition of-the poor. Such-a-kind what was-it? The through the lamentations and the dirges having-come-about, a-kind-of some request having concerning the holding-them terrible-things.
pass_b_english: “He did not forget the petition of the poor” (Psalm 9:13).
What sort was it? The one that came about through lamentations and dirges, having a kind of request concerning the terrible things that hold them.

choices.why: ἐπιλανθάνομαι aorist, negated. Not ἐπιλαμβάνομαι ‘take hold of’, and not inverted as ‘remember’.
δέησις is the psalm’s petition/supplication, not a generic ‘prayer’.
rejected: plea of the needy as a woman

choices.why: Asks what kind of petition it was (feminine δέησις). Not ‘she who became’.
rejected: what is this? she who became

choices.english: concerning the terrible things that hold them
choices.why: κατέχω + δεινά: the evils that hold the poor, not ‘oppressors of evils’.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
